jobs.title: Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology - Ophthalmology
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

**How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 177 years?!**

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast\-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality \& Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!  



  

**What’s the role?**

  

The Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology Ophthalmology is responsible for leading the Canadian commercial strategy, sales execution, revenue growth, profitability and market development for the Ophthalmic Devices business.


This role provides leadership across key Ophthalmic Devices segments, including ophthalmic diagnostics, surgical ophthalmology, refractive solutions, retina, anterior segment and related clinical education or professional development activities, as applicable to the Canadian market.


The incumbent is accountable for achieving annual revenue and profit objectives, developing a high\-performing sales organization, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring alignment with ZEISS Canada priorities, regional business objectives and global Ophthalmic Devices strategies.


The role is also responsible for providing business insights to Canadian and regional leadership on market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, product requirements, pricing, territory planning and growth opportunities within the Canadian ophthalmology and optometry markets.  



  

**Sound Interesting?**

**Here’s what you’ll do:**  



***Commercial Strategy and Business Planning***

  

* Develop and execute the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices commercial strategy in alignment with ZEISS Canada, regional and global business priorities.
* Lead the achievement of annual revenue, profit and market share objectives for the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices business.
* Develop annual business plans, sales forecasts, expense budgets and growth initiatives.
* Provide regular business updates, sales funnel reviews and forecast submissions to Canadian and regional leadership.
* Lead monthly business reviews using data\-driven performance analysis
* Lead capital equipment opportunity planning from lead generation through installation, customer adoption and lifecycle management.
* Monitor installed base performance, replacement opportunities and cross\-selling opportunities across the customer portfolio.
* Recommend pricing strategies, promotional programs, territory planning, resource allocation and future product opportunities based on Canadian market needs.
Identify incremental business opportunities with strategic partners, key accounts and healthcare institutions.  
* 

  

***Sales Leadership and Performance Management***

  

* Lead the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices sales organization in achieving annual sales and profitability targets.
* Build, coach and develop a high\-performing sales team through effective recruitment, onboarding, motivation, mentoring and performance management.
* Establish clear sales goals, territory expectations and accountability measures.
* Support career development, succession planning and talent growth within the Canadian sales organization.
* Operate as a player\-coach by actively participating in strategic customer engagements, major sales presentations, executive\-level negotiations, and key opportunity pursuits.
* Conduct regular performance discussions and annual performance reviews in accordance with ZEISS Canada HR policies.
* Partner with Regional Sales Managers and Account Managers to develop account strategies, advance complex opportunities, and accelerate sales cycle progression.
* Conduct regular field coaching, joint customer visits, and opportunity reviews to improve sales effectiveness and support professional development across the commercial organization.
* Leverage Salesforce as the primary commercial management platform and single source of truth for pipeline management, account planning, forecasting, opportunity coaching, performance management, and commercial analytics, ensuring data integrity, visibility, and sales execution across the organization.
* Utilize CRM analytics to drive territory optimization, resource allocation, customer segmentation and business planning decisions.
* Utilize Salesforce analytics and reporting to support territory optimization, customer segmentation, resource allocation, forecasting accuracy, and strategic business planning.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, customer focus and achievement.  
* 

  

***Market Development and Competitive Intelligence***

  

* Monitor and evaluate Canadian market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, procurement practices and emerging opportunities in ophthalmology and optometry.
* Provide regular and meaningful insights to Canadian and regional leadership on market conditions, customer requirements, product needs and competitive positioning.
* Analyze market intelligence, customer feedback, sales data and pipeline information to identify risks and growth opportunities.
* Recommend strategies to strengthen ZEISS’s market position in Canada.
Reinforce ZEISS’s brand as a trusted market leader in ophthalmic technology and solutions.  
* 

  

***Customer and Strategic Account Management***

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, ophthalmologists, optometrists, clinics, hospitals, academic institutions and buying groups.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis - SLC Management
jobs.description:
SLC Management is a growing global asset management firm providing innovative and diversified investment solutions to institutional investors. We are breaking new ground with a full spectrum of solutions for a growing institutional client base of more than 1400 organizations. Our history of organic and strategic growth reflects this commitment with over CA$422/US$304 billion in assets under management (AUM). As a subsidiary of Sun Life, we are aligned with one of the world’s leading financial services companies, and benefit from the stability and strength of that relationship.


We are a performance\-driven organization with a deliberate focus on fostering a development\-focused, inclusive culture revolving around our Core Values of being **client obsessed** , **valuing each other** , **acting with speed** and **having an owner’s mindset** . As part of our team, you play a role in fulfilling our purpose and making a difference. We offer a rewarding work environment that is filled with opportunity for growth where you will be empowered to meet the challenges of a highly competitive landscape.


Visit our website to learn more and for the most up to date AUM information.


SLC Management offers a mix of in\-office and virtual work where our employees are empowered to do their best. Generally, employees are expected to work three or more days in\-office each week with flexibility depending on their business, client and team needs.


**Job Description:**

  

* Join SLC Management's Toronto\-based team as a Director/Senior Director, FP\&A in a highly visible role that extends well beyond traditional financial planning and analysis. In addition to leading management reporting, forecasting, and strategic planning, you will support investor relations, financial modeling, business analytics, and corporate strategy across a global alternatives platform. The role offers regular interaction with SLC Management's executive team, business leaders, and Sun Life partners.
* This position is ideal for a commercially minded finance leader who combines analytical rigor with sound business judgment and enjoys translating complex data into actionable insights. You will thrive in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment where priorities evolve quickly, continuous learning is expected, and there may be opportunities to lead and develop finance talent.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the financial and strategic direction of one of the industry's fastest\-growing alternatives platforms. As SLC Management continues to expand across private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and fixed income, you will partner directly with senior leadership on critical growth, investment, and business decisions while building a strong platform for future career advancement.  
* 

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**  



* **Management reporting —** Lead the preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting packages, including AUM and fee\-earning AUM roll\-forwards, fee\-related earnings, management and performance fee revenue, expenses, margin, and headcount, with clear commentary on drivers, trends, and variances to plan
* **Planning and forecasting —** Own key components of the annual budget, multi\-year business plan, and rolling forecast process across business units and corporate functions; partner with business leaders to build, challenge, and validate assumptions
* **Business and strategic planning —** Support the enterprise strategic planning cycle, including long\-range financial projections, growth ambition setting, capital allocation analysis, and evaluation of new products, strategies, and investment platforms
* **Financial modeling —** Build and maintain robust, auditable models covering fundraising and deployment pacing, fee revenue build\-ups, seed and co\-investment capital, expense structures, product\-level and client\-level profitability, and scenario and sensitivity analysis
* **Investor relations support —** Prepare analysis, talking points, and supporting materials for Sun Life quarterly earnings disclosure, investor day content, analyst questions, and peer benchmarking against publicly traded alternative asset managers
* **Executive and Board materials —** Develop clear, well\-structured presentations and written analysis for the SLC Management executive team, Sun Life senior leadership, and Board audiences
* **Strategy and analytics —** Conduct competitive, market, and peer analysis on AUM growth, fee rates, margins, fund performance, and industry trends; deliver insight\-driven recommendations rather than data alone
* **Business partnership —** Act as a trusted finance partner to business unit leaders, investment teams, distribution, and corporate functions, supporting ad hoc analysis, business cases, and decision support
* **Process improvement —** Drive continuous improvement in planning tools, reporting templates, data quality, and dashboards to increase speed, accuracy, and insight
* **Generative AI adoption —** Apply generative AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate and strengthen FP\&A work — from research and peer benchmarking to drafting, model documentation, data summarization, and reporting automation — and help establish practical standards for how the team uses these tools responsibly and with appropriate review
* **Cross\-functional collaboration —** Work closely with Controllership, Tax, Capital \& Treasury, Investor Relations, Human Resources, and Sun Life corporate Finance to ensure consistency and integrity of financial information
* **Leadership —** Where applicable, manage, coach, and develop finance talent, setting clear standards for analytical quality and attention to detail

  

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:**

  

* **Intellectual curiosity –** actively seeks to understand what drives the business, asks the next question, and pursues the “why” behind the numbers
* **Exceptional attention to detail –** produces work that is accurate, internally consistent, and exec

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis - SLC Management
jobs.description:
Gestion SLC est une société de gestion d’actifs d’envergure mondiale en croissance qui offre des solutions de placement novatrices et diversifiées aux investisseurs institutionnels. Nous innovons en proposant une gamme complète de solutions à une clientèle institutionnelle en expansion, constituée de plus de 1 400 organisations. Notre historique de croissance interne et stratégique reflète cet engagement, comme en témoigne notre actif géré de plus de 422 G$ CA (304 G$ US). À titre de filiale de la Sun Life, Gestion SLC profite d’une relation solide et stable avec une des plus importantes sociétés de services financiers du monde.


Nous sommes une organisation propulsée par la performance et nous favorisons une culture inclusive axée sur le perfectionnement qui repose sur des valeurs fondamentales telles que **mettre le Client au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons** , **se valoriser mutuellement** , **agir avec rapidité** et **adopter l’instinct du propriétaire** . Notre équipe aura besoin de vous pour exceller et concrétiser sa raison d’être. Nous offrons un environnement de travail gratifiant où les possibilités de croissance sont nombreuses et où vous serez encouragé à répondre aux enjeux de notre secteur fortement concurrentiel, et outillé pour le faire.


Pour en savoir plus et pour consulter l’information la plus récente sur notre actif géré, rendez\-vous sur notre site Web.  



  

À Gestion SLC vous évoluerez dans un environnement combinant la présence au bureau et le travail à distance, où notre personnel est outillé pour donner le meilleur de lui\-même. Généralement, les employés doivent travailler au moins 3 jours par semaine au bureau et peuvent choisir les jours qui leur conviennent selon les besoins de la société, des Clients et de leur équipe.
